title: Broken link to pricing page
description: The 'Pricing' navigation link results in a 404 error when accessed.
steps_to_reproduce: Click on the 'Pricing' link in the top navigation bar.

title: Sign-up form and task management controls are unresponsive
description: Submitting the sign-up form or adding new tasks produces no visible change or feedback on the page across all interaction attempts.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter text into the email or task input fields.
evidence: Experiment log steps where click/fill actions result in 'text_changed: false' and 'html_changed: false'.

title: Reference error in console regarding tracking
description: A JavaScript reference error occurs in the console stating that 'trackPageView is not defined'.
steps_to_reproduce: Load the web application http://localhost:8000 and check the browser console.

title: Missing accessible labels on interactive form elements
description: Multiple interactive elements such as the email input, buttons, and navigation links lack proper accessible labels, failing accessibility standards.
steps_to_reproduce: Run an accessibility audit on the page.
evidence: elements list shows multiple items with 'labelled: false', including the email input, signup button, add button, and clear button.
